notes.title: Liftoff! (And some minor patches)
notes.notes:
Hey Divers, 

First of all, we wanted to thank you for all your support through launch week! DIVE: Starpath means so much to us as developers, and we are over the moon with the response. We've been keeping close tabs on the community boards, Let's Plays, and recommends, and have implemented some fixes detailed below. 

Patch Notes  for DIVE: Starpath 1.01
[list][*]Fixed a bug with the Ace achievements not triggering. [*] Fixed a bug with the Explorer achievement not triggering. [/list]

Thanks for bringing these issues to our attention and for playing the DIVE: Starpath. We'll have more news for you soon, so keep an eye on the skies. 

-Gravity Well Team
